title: Revision search entries
responsibility: Builds searchable entity summaries bound to the displayed commit.

inputs.name: explorerSearchEntries.entities
inputs.description: Explorer entities from the displayed revision. Removed entities are omitted.

inputs.name: explorerSearchEntries.commit
inputs.description: Commit identifier attached to every search entry.

outputs.name: explorerSearchEntries
outputs.description: Search entries containing identifier, category, display name, purpose and contract field names, with the supplied commit. No owned source paths are added.
